title: With G3 on, closing the window keeps tinyclient running in the tray, the icon's click brings the window back, and its Quit ends tinyclient and chatd

not_applicable.macos: Closing already hides the window and keeps chatd receiving behind Keep receiving (G2); a menu bar icon is the macOS side of G3 and is not built.
not_applicable.linux: The tray (StatusNotifierItem) is a later stage of the G3 work; the systemd user unit holds chatd today.
not_applicable.android: The phone has no window close and no tray.
